Heatmap of document similarity

Source: R/similarity.R
plot_similarity.Rd

Heatmap of document similarity

Usage

plot_similarity(
  s,
  order = TRUE,
  labels = length(s$doc_ids) <= 40,
  values = length(s$doc_ids) <= 30,
  digits = 2
)

Arguments

s

A result from [doc_similarity()].

order

If `TRUE` (default), reorder abstracts so that similar ones sit together (hierarchical clustering).

labels

Show reference ids on the axes? Defaults to `TRUE` for up to 40 abstracts.

values

Print the similarity number inside each box? Defaults to `TRUE` for up to 30 abstracts; with more, the numbers get too small to read.

digits

Decimal places for the numbers (default 2).

Value

A ggplot object.
